Description: Detected a Generic API Key, potentially exposing access to various services and sensitive operations.
Author: Masudur Rahman
Message:
Add the admin re-ingest control to the policies board

One control per distinct version, on that version's first row, posting the
three-key body with a freshly minted idempotency key. A version that is not
live arms first, because re-ingesting it makes it live. The board owns the
query key and hands down an invalidation; the control owns its arming, its
in-flight flag, its alert and its result line.

The proxy route now bounds the call at 35 seconds, above agent-api's own MCP
read timeout, so the tool's typed refusal reaches the browser rather than the
proxy aborting an ingest that is still running.

Description: Detected a Generic API Key, potentially exposing access to various services and sensitive operations.
Author: Masudur Rahman
Message:
Reach the two notification tools over HTTP and parse their answers

Two agent-api routes over the 23ga tools, two web proxies and one parser, no
page. The read stamp's idempotency key is derived from the verified reader and
the notification under the same namespace and separator as the other three
derivations, so a double-clicked bell replays rather than filing a second call.
The page size and the unread filter stay the tool's, and the stamp carries no
body at all.

Description: Detected a Generic API Key, potentially exposing access to various services and sensitive operations.
Author: Masudur Rahman
Message:
Put the approval queue and the two decisions on the wire

The queue row widens from twelve fields to twenty, fed by one statement with
four joins so the names and the stored decision trace arrive with each request
instead of costing a directory read per row.

Agent-api gains GET /me/approvals and the two POST decision routes over the
same MCP tools the agent calls, with the idempotency key derived from the
approver, the request and the verb - a double-clicked Approve replays the
stored response rather than filing a second decision. The route plumbing moves
into deps so later rows share one typed-refusal map.

Description: Detected a Generic API Key, potentially exposing access to various services and sensitive operations.
Author: Masudur Rahman
Message:
Widen my-requests and put both reads on the wire

list_my_requests now answers nineteen fields instead of nine, resolved in one
joined read alongside the request's grant, and two agent-api routes plus two
Next proxies put it and list_my_access in front of the browser. The reads go
through the MCP boundary so RBAC, the kill switch and the audit event still
apply, and the caller's own bearer is forwarded verbatim.

Description: Detected a Generic API Key, potentially exposing access to various services and sensitive operations.
Author: Masudur Rahman
Message:
Serve the MCP tool pipeline over streamable HTTP

Every tool call now passes one seam: identity from the JWT, then the kill
switch, then RBAC, then argument validation, then a tenant-bound session.
The seam answers with one of the eight typed codes and nothing else, and
writes exactly one audit event per call. The failure event comes from a
fresh session so it survives the rollback it records.

get_me and list_my_access are the first two tools. Both are self-scoped and
ignore any user named in their arguments.

Adds a connect timeout to the one engine factory and both timeout halves to
the kill switch and readiness clients: Redis and Postgres are on the path of
every call, and a dropped packet would otherwise hang it forever.
